reviewed_refs.resolution_policy: Resolve remote heads immediately before candidate construction.

review_outcome.required_action: Construct a successor candidate from current accepted F0 and M0 roots plus the net current A0 branch, then run the focused source packet and canonical Kaggle Review Preview.

include_from_current_a0.required_net_effect: Retain the current density switch, persisted selection, both target representations, keyboard/pinch behavior and anchor continuity.

must_not_select_as_final_net_effect.reason: It removed the accepted user-facing Popular density model and was explicitly rejected by N0. A later restoration may remain in branch history; only the restored net tree is acceptable.

must_not_select_as_final_net_effect.pattern: source test that asserts ListingMobileDensitySwitch, mobile-large, mobile-adaptive or ke_listing_density_v2 are obsolete
must_not_select_as_final_net_effect.reason: The assertion contradicts the accepted product behavior.

must_not_select_as_final_net_effect.pattern: pre-M0 OptimizedEventCardGrid implementation that imports EventCard or packRelatedCardRows and owns grid/media CSS
must_not_select_as_final_net_effect.reason: The accepted form is a thin AdaptiveEventCardGrid compatibility adapter.

must_not_select_as_final_net_effect.pattern: consumer-local object-fit/object-position or handwritten rail anatomy after the matching R0 mechanical unit is applied
must_not_select_as_final_net_effect.reason: MediaFrame and EventMediaRail are the accepted M0 owners.

integration_order.action: Resolve current candidate/F0/M0/A0 heads and verify ancestry.
Integrate current accepted F0 foundation files.
Integrate current accepted M0 MediaFrame, EventMediaRail, EventCard and AdaptiveEventCardGrid roots plus M0 regression contracts.
Integrate the current A0 net tree; on conflicts prefer accepted F0/M0 root APIs and reapply A0 consumer bindings without dropping product behavior.
Run the combined focused F0/M0/A0 source and regression packet.
Invoke the one canonical Kaggle full Review Preview; verify exact identity and HTTP 200; trigger V0.

conflict_rules.winner: thin compatibility adapter over current M0 AdaptiveEventCardGrid
A0 restored density behavior and positive regression contract

preserve: A0 caller behavior and route composition
A0 consumer references that resolve to defined aliases

focused_acceptance: Every A0 var(--ke-*) reference resolves after combined integration.
Popular density behavior remains present and protected.
OptimizedEventCardGrid is only a compatibility adapter.
Mechanical units are each entirely pre-state or post-state; no partial migration.
All grouped route bindings still total nine and do not claim browser/Penpot completion.
No current F0/M0 canonical root is modified by A0 conflict resolution.

rollback.rule: Revert the smallest failing A0 unit or R0 mechanical subunit. Do not revert canonical F0/M0 roots or accepted Popular behavior to resolve one consumer failure.
